newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Cisco trades lower.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Cisco trades lower.

text.p: Cisco Systems Inc was trading at 56 during the after-hours session against a close of 57-3/4 on the Nasdaq Stock Market following the release of its quarterly earnings, traders said Tuesday.
"That's basically the one that's moving," said one dealer, adding that other stocks were fairly quiet.

Cisco reported earnings of $0.52 a share for the third quarter, excluding a gain of $0.03, compared with $0.37 a share for the same period a year ago. The result was in line with analysts' expectations for earnings of $0.52 a share, according to First Call consensus estimates.
Another dealer later said the company's stock had slipped to 55-5/8.
"It's tapering off," she said, referring to the trading activity surrounding the stock.
Other companies also saw the price of their stock fall in quiet trading.
3Com Corp slipped to 35-1/8 against a close of 35-3/4, while Cascade Communications Corp was at 33-3/8 against 33-3/4.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one had a volume of 7,700 shares against 13,900 on Monday. Session two had 2.4 million compared with 245,400 the previous day.
